positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed multiple components and functions for a responsive web application, utilizing HTML, CSS, and Javascript, plus incorporated API integration for online payment processing. 
- Successfully designed and built 3 interactive web applications utilizing cutting-edge technologies, including Gatsby, Node, and AWS ensuring user-friendliness and scalability.
- Improved UI/UX design, implemented ideal user flow, and tested applications in various browsers.
- Actively collaborated with other developers to ensure accuracy and quality of the applications.
- Authored over a dozen Node & MySQL scripts for the backend of an application with over 3K users.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
- Managed e-commerce operations using tools such as Yoast, Shopify, Helium 10, and Google Analytics to keep track of trends resulting in a 30% increase of website traffic.
- Successfully executed the relaunch of the Energy Times website, incorporating a modern design and innovative techniques to enhance user experience and brand image. 
- Utilized Wordpress as the Content Management System (CMS) to effectively manage website content and ensure efficient updates.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
Been with the organization since High School. Was never fully involved until now, and I am so grateful to have been apart of this amazing community. We connect with women in CS, build our network, expand our CS experience, and use community organizing tactics to empower women in CS on college campuses. 
Our first meeting consisted of getting to know one another, everyone there was so approachable and friendly. We all decided to stick together and help one another in our classes. We wanted also to possible attend hackathons together in the future. 
During other meetings, we designed games, learned new languages, and improved our problem solving skills all by finishing tasks that the Girls Who Code Organization had provided for us. We struggle with the same doubts and we lean on each other to make it through school and life. Excited to continue being a part of this wonderful group of women!

positions.title: NYU VIP Program
positions.description:
Been here for 3 semesters now, have learned a lot about computer networking and working with Unity. for the first couple of weeks it was all learning how to use scripts in Visual Studio and running them on Unity. Afterwards we got into coding the actual functions to push buttons and turn knobs so that it could be visually seen through the HoloLens. 
The following semester I was tasked with getting a server up and running and testing to see if it can connect with the Unity program. We knew it could be done because there were plenty of tutorials online to follow. After testing non-stop, I finally got to build a server and test it with a client script on Unity, the two communicated and sent data to one another in real time.
Now I am testing to see if I can get the Unity scripts to run on the HoloLens while the computer is running the server. We'll see how it goes!

projects.title: StonyBrook Hackathon
projects.description: LUNACY serves as a fun gaming platform to teach children about space. While playing as Ray, kids will be prompted with space trivia to test their knowledge of our galaxy! As they continue to travel our universe, they will encounter space phenomena and challenges which they must over come, as they continue to learn about the wonders of our infinite space.

projects.title: Flawless Hackathon
projects.description: We created a platform for muscians and artists trying to make it in the music industry. It would allow them to connect with venues, recording labels, and also fans.
